  > 
  > **Evidence.** `pdffonts` on the system builds of `dev` (built-from 4c8174310b09) and `main` (b44a3af2f1ca) lists one font of type *Type 3* (object 88, no name): the bitmap ectt fonts TeX makes for `\texttt`/`\url` under `\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}` when no Type 1 outline for T1 typewriter is installed. It is used on p. 1 (the "email" footnote from the style file) and in the checklist (`\texttt{code/}`, URLs). All figure PDFs embed TrueType (checked), so figures are fine.
  > 
  > **Fix, tested.** In `paper/main.tex` add after `\usepackage{microtype}`: `\usepackage{courier}` (psnfss, in the same TeX Live as the build). Local build of `dev` 4c81743 with that line: 0 Type 3 fonts (NimbusMonL Type 1 instead), 32 pages, References still start on p. 9 at the same line (y = 654 pt). Your call whether to use `courier` or another Type 1 typewriter font (`beramono`).
  > 
  > **Separate, for the report's checklist/appendix wording.** experiment-repo (`experiment-repo`#4) corrected its compute figures: the "CPU-hours" are wall-clock hours of single-threaded jobs (upper bound of CPU time), main 3.3 h, sensitivity 1.4 h, recalibrated and weak-prior 2.7 h, IRT-setting check 1.45 h (48 jobs), published-code runs 2.0 h (26 files), 1 core and < 6 GB per job. `paper/appendix/reproducibility.tex` on `dev` still says CPU-hours and that the check's time was not measured. The checklist asks for the type of workers, memory and time, so state these.
